title: Multi-label versus multi-class classification of blood cells and their aggregates in microfluidic channels
abstract: arXiv:2609.07410v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deformability cytometry (DC) is a type of imaging flow cytometry, which uses a camera-equipped device to measure cellular stiffness in addition to other cellular properties at high throughput. Cellular properties such as area and elongation can identify cell types, but this requires prior knowledge of distinguishing properties and cannot be applied to clinically important cell aggregates. Using DC data, we evaluated conventional multi-class (MC) classification and introduced a multi-label (ML) approach for identifying blood cells and their aggregates. In particular, an ML classifier can simultaneously assign multiple cell-type labels to a single imaged event. We show that, unlike MC classification, ML classification can identify cell aggregates not represented in the training data. translated_title: 微流控通道中血细胞及其聚集体的多标签与多类别分类对比研究
translated_abstract: 形变细胞术是一种成像流式细胞术，它使用配备相机的设备在高通量条件下测量细胞刚度以及其他细胞特性。面积和伸长率等细胞特性可用于识别细胞类型，但这需要预先了解区分性特征，且无法应用于临床上重要的细胞聚集体。利用DC数据，我们评估了传统的多类别分类方法，并提出了一种多标签方法来识别血细胞及其聚集体。具体而言，ML分类器可以同时为单个成像事件分配多个细胞类型标签。我们表明，与多类别分类不同，多标签分类能够识别训练数据中未出现过的细胞聚集体。它还避免了使用详尽、严格定义的聚集体标签的需要，从而简化并加快了标注过程。由于自动血液分析仪...（摘要不完整）
tldr: 本文提出在形变细胞术中用多标签分类替代传统多类别分类来识别血细胞及其聚集体，能够识别训练数据中未出现过的细胞聚集体，同时简化并加快了数据标注过程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multi-label classification approach for identifying blood cells and their aggregates in deformability cytometry, which can detect aggregates not represented in training data while simplifying and accelerating annotation compared to conventional multi-class classification.
